build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm -w run sidecar:placeholder && pnpm --filter @geeked/bridge build && pnpm --filter @geeked/desktop dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm -w run sidecar && pnpm --filter @geeked/bridge build && pnpm --filter @geeked/desktop build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://raw.githubusercontent.com; frame-src preview: http://preview.localhost https://preview.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A desktop app for prompting about code, on your Claude subscription
bundle.longDescription: Geeked is a lightweight desktop client for developers who mostly prompt about code. It runs on your Claude Code login: chat, code blocks and diffs, live previews, a prompt library, and usage tracking.
